articles.title: Ann Widdecombe murder probe: What we know so far
articles.description: Police say they are searching for a suspect in connection with the former MP's death at her home on Dartmoor.

articles.title: Anton du Beke 'devastated' over Ann Widdecombe death as politicians share shock at murder probe
articles.description: Kemi Badenoch said the Conservative Party was "reeling" as the former minister's death is investigated as murder.

articles.title: Watch: Police confirm 26 year-old suspect in custody
articles.description: A 26-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of murder following the death of Ann Widdecombe, police say.

articles.title: Watch: 'Shocked' Starmer and Badenoch react to murder investigation
articles.description: The prime minister and opposition leader spoke after the police announced a murder investigation into the death of Ann Widdecombe.
